component.name: ComfortAir
component.description: Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.

component.name: VariPuck S3 Gimbal Mount
component.description: The VariPuck fits between your weapon and the ship hardpoint to transform a fixed weapon mount into a gimballed mount, allowing the pilot to independently aim their weapon’s fire. VariPucks will accept any weapon the same size as the hardpoint it is mounting to.

component.name: Mantis GT-220 Gatling
component.description: The Mantis GT-220 is a hydraulically-driven Gatling-type rotary cannon designed to deliver smaller rounds at a very high rate of fire. The Mantis is designed to shred armor on very fast targets, sacrificing power for absolute saturation of the target area.

component.name: Self Destruct Unit
component.description: Self Destruct Unit

component.name: Slipstream
component.description: Tyler Design & Tech uses an expensive alloy on its Slipstream power plant to reduce its overall emissions. This design choice is key to making this small power plant’s detectable signature one of the lowest on the market.

component.name: HeatSafe
component.description: Pilots looking to keep their IR signature low rely on Tyler Design & Tech. As an entry level cooler, the HeatSafe not only limits emissions, it is built with Tyler’s satisfaction guarantee.

component.name: Shimmer
component.description: Ascension Astro is known for one thing — quality stealth components. Their Shimmer shield generator was built not only to help avoid detection, but also provide protection when needed most.

component.name: MSD-582 Missile Rack
component.description: Behring’s MSD-582 "Marsden" is a complete ordnance storage and deployment system that can be mounted on any compatible size 5 hardpoint for the reliable and effective launch of eight S2 missiles.

component.name: Dominator II Missile
component.description: Designed to track an opponent’s electromagnetic signature, the Dominator strike missile is a precision ordnance package designed to establish tactical battlefield dominance.
